name: LOFT
description: LOFT is a benchmark of real-world tasks requiring context up to millions of tokens, designed to evaluate long-context language models' performance on in-context retrieval and reasoning tasks.
reputation: A relatively new long-context benchmark that has been cited in long-context model evaluations, but it is not yet as widely adopted as established benchmarks like LongBench or Needle-in-a-Haystack variants.
notes: Focuses on evaluating LCLMs on retrieval and reasoning with very long contexts, highlighting challenges in compositional reasoning and the impact of prompting strategies.
